requirements.requirement: The system must define a sponsor_type enum with allowed values: NIH, Industry, Academic, Other.
The system must include a credibility_score field as a float constrained between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive.
The system must include an explanation field as a non-empty string describing how the sponsor credibility was determined.
The system must structure the schema as a Pydantic model compatible with existing clinical_trials_models.py patterns.
The system must accept sponsor metadata inputs including lead_sponsor and collaborators from clinical_trials_service without transformation errors.
The system must map agency_class input values to the sponsor_type enum without loss of information.
The system must ensure the schema is serializable to JSON for inclusion in API responses.
The system must ensure backward compatibility with existing facade response models by not breaking existing required fields.
The system must validate that credibility_score is present whenever sponsor_type is present.
The system must allow explanation to include sponsor name and type context derived from input metadata.
The system must default sponsor_type to Other when agency_class is missing or unrecognized.
The system must default credibility_score to a valid value within range when sponsor metadata is missing.
The system must not allow null values for sponsor_type, credibility_score, or explanation in the final schema output.
The system must raise a validation error if credibility_score is outside the 0 to 1 range.
The system must raise a validation error if sponsor_type is not one of the defined enum values.
